page.overview:
Who is Candle Bear?

The Candle Bear is a character from WarioWare: Move It!. He is featured as the main protagonist of the microgame of the same name.

The Candle Bear is a brown bear. He bears a white and blue birthday candle in each hand.

The Candle Bear appears in this game, where he is featured as the main protagonist of the Boss Microgame of Mona's level, Mermaid Meet and Greet. Here, the Candle Bear has to protect his candles as ants try to extinguish them, then use said candles to ignite the frozen fuse of a cannon, allowing him to keep the cake out of their hands. Getting both his candles extinguished causes the player to lose, at which point he sweats as the ants prepare to eat the cake.

The Candle Bear and Microgame that he appears in derive their names from "candle bearer." Category:Animals Category:WarioWare series Category:WarioWare: Move It! Category:Characters in WarioWare: Move It!
